title: Two Chicken Fries
description: a modpacks that’s fun to play with friends!
body:
a modpack between a group of friends on a self-hosted fabric server.

This is a great modpack for those who don't want a complete vanilla experience or a overly modded experience.

this modpacks contains notable
mods such as:
- Mr.Crayfish's Furniture Mod
- Immersive Aircraft Mod
- Animal Garden Mods
- Farmer's Delight
- Image2MapMan
- Polymer Tools

Ty modrinth for making this process of playing a Modded Server much easier! - blu
